$meta.name: HR AI governance prototype — design tokens
$meta.status: validation prototype only — not a production design system
changeLog: 2026-10-07 (GOM-95): added the `applicability` scale — a second, orthogonal axis to `status`, carrying when a duty binds. Severity gained an explicit medium-high grade entry to match the evidence pack's scale.

brand-soft.use: active nav bg, brand pill bg

mediumHigh.label: Medium-high
mediumHigh.note: exists only because the evidence pack uses that grade

applicability.note: When a duty binds. Deliberately NOT on the status scale and never reusing an ok/warn/bad colour: a duty's application date is orthogonal to whether you hold the document for it. Rendered as a small marker directly under the status pill, under the gap title, and under each obligation-track heading. Text always states the date; colour only reinforces it.
applicability.rule: A Partial or Missing status on a duty that is not yet applicable is a readiness gap, not a contravention. The two must never be flattened into one visual.

dualTrack.use: a row with one live limb and one deferred limb (e.g. GDPR Art. 13 + AI Act Art. 26(11)) takes the `live` style and names both limbs with their dates in one marker — never two stacked markers

decisionRole.note: The spine of the product. Always rendered as a labelled pill, never colour-only.

typography.family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

layout.approach: desktop-first; used at a laptop, not a phone

breakpoints.belowSupported: <1024px shows a 'best viewed on a laptop' notice

components.note: shadcn/ui equivalents named so an engineer can map 1:1 if this ever gets built.

map.decision role pill: Badge variant=outline with explicit label text
map.boundary strip: Alert variant=default, sticky, non-dismissible, carrying the dated applicability statement plus a Collapsible for the full four-track breakdown and its sources
map.triage stepper: custom Stepper + Collapsible (citation on demand) + Card
map.export: Card + Checkbox list + Button + Progress + Alert (gap warning)
map.applicability marker: Badge variant=secondary/outline + a visually-hidden "Applicable now." / "Not applicable yet." prefix

a11y.minContrast: 4.5:1 for all text; verified per token above
a11y.colourIndependence: every status, severity and applicability marker carries a text label and a glyph; the applicability marker additionally carries a screen-reader-only "Applicable now." / "Not applicable yet." prefix
a11y.keyboard: all interactive elements are native button/a/input; stepper is arrow-key navigable; no click-only affordances
a11y.landmarks: header / nav / main / footer, skip-to-content link first in tab order
a11y.liveRegions: aria-live=polite on triage confirmation and export result

outOfScope: any employee-level or candidate-level personal data
